name: curious_explorer
description: Explores a couple of structural changes before settling. Should exercise split + rename + accept.
goal: Identify a cluster that mixes distinct sub-themes and ask for it to be split. Then rename one cluster to something more descriptive. Once the structure feels coherent, declare yourself satisfied.

notes.tone: curious, methodical, references cluster names explicitly when giving feedback
notes.extra: Always reference clusters by name when asking for changes. Avoid touching point-level details.
